binding.status: implemented; CPU integration checkpoint; visual/performance acceptance open

forest_cache.status: 352 observed far/middle/near cells stride1; bounded product cache; other cells/strides use exact generator fallback

generator_policy.placement: world-fixed source-checked local grouping of existing candidates; same crown height/family; no broad body

identity.support_policy: explicit global dyadic stride; zero flat; named-star geometry; marine zero; no relief; no node-residency dependence

canonical_source_sampling.role_selection: final composed SDF<=0 land; otherwise nearest associated_role from finest valid positive-weight domain, no role lerp

terrain_shadow_policy.reason: isolated same-frozen-scene controls bind terrain selfshadow stripes; conscious display decision, no overall style/performance pass

policy.kernel: fixed land-only 3x3 Gaussian weights1/2/4 at4km axis offsets; coastal/water samples retain original height
policy.named_anchor_protection: C2 radial weight returns to original local source height; exact named point inserted into its fixed grid cell
policy.fixed_surface_definition: unchanged2km RG8 triangular grid definition and named anchor star cells; globally fixed across every zoom
policy.render_method: exact fixed-grid triangles with shared indices and bounded streamed chunks; no height simplification or parent morph
policy.dominant_source_landforms: the fixed4km field suppresses minor peaks; dominant source structures and named shoulders belong to the field, not per-view selection
policy.source_to_grid_node_generalization_scope: all fixed grid nodes; not all original native source centers or all triangle interiors
policy.macrofacet_partition: global24km addresses; source-land representative closest to local mean plus dominant ridge/valley extrema; source node positions; Delaunay interpolation; coast/water and named-original shoulders protected

river_valley_protection.bound_scope: source line vertices and <=1km dense segment samples, not missing rivers, hydraulic flow or historical180 shore validation

policy.source_to_model_bound_after_river_protec: convex mixture of the bound base and macro grid-node samples; must be remeasured against the bound canonical source after river protection; no native source accuracy claim

display_policy.status: implemented calibration candidate; visual acceptance pending
display_policy.contract_change: Visible terrain vertical scaling differs from horizontal scaling. Supersedes previous display-isotropy requirement under current explicit diorama-replica request; source and canonical model remain isotropic.
display_policy.source_claim: 12 is an own testable display parameter, not a measured original engine parameter.

display_coast_distance_binding.status: implementiert; graphic transport, GPU/style validation pending

display_coast_distance_binding.raster_contract: full domain extent; first pixel center at min+size/(2*dimensions); sample uv*N-.5; no synthetic outer-rectangle boundary
display_coast_distance_binding.definition: unsigned nearest composed-source marine/nonmarine boundary-cell center; EDT on both adjoining cell centers, no new physical coast or water role
display_coast_distance_binding.uncertainty_note: conservative one-cell diagonal relative to raster boundary; does not bound vector/source coastline accuracy; original exact near-shore SDF still owns contour
display_coast_distance_binding.inland_role_rule: role2 never marine; distance may exist there but shader retains inland original path

graphic_rock_priority_contract: fixed regular Atlas h/gradient; N inverse fixed display Y, no relief/zoom; semantic G bilinear mip0; max(G,smoothstep(.06,.25,1-N.y),.85*smoothstep(1250,2700,h)); source forest membership unchanged

river_surface_binding.triangle_clip: river polygons clipped against exact active-stride terrain triangles; source centerlines unchanged
river_surface_binding.width_policy: same symbolic source-rank width and pixel floor, centerline unchanged

height_range_snapshot.snapshot_rule: read-only stable bounds for this frame; no camera/cloud recursion

cloud_layer_binding.provider_api: get_displayed_height_range() returns immutable frame snapshot; cloud get_display_altitude() read before camera clipping

protected_render_lod.transition_limit: incremental surface replacement and cross-LOD popping require continuous-tour validation
protected_render_lod.surface_contract: render mesh and barycentric CPU height are identical; forest signs await mesh queue and regenerate overlapping supports
